rapport_notes: Patient re-explaining the full move scope when the customer's own math didn't match the estimate.

evidence_quotes.agenda: what are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today? / Customer: 'Just more refinement on the price and I guess more detail of like the certain items.'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: The entire rest of the call (room-by-room item list, elevator access, then a revised, itemized estimate) directly served the customer's stated need for pricing detail.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Let's say your move ends quicker than what we have expected. Then we'll still charge you for the minimum... once we go over the minimum the time is pro-rated (window/proration framing, but no full 5-line sequence).

top_strength: Recalculated and clearly re-explained the estimate when the customer's own 2-hour guess didn't match the quote, walking through the full scope (wrap, load, drive, unload, reassemble) until it made sense.
coaching_note: On-Time Guarantee was never mentioned anywhere in the call, and the call ended on 'send me the estimate to review' with no explicit booking ask — both are easy misses to fix before he shops around.
